inputs.text: {"high_level_description": "A piece of a pixel art battle stage background at its own pixel size: a crimson eclipse sky with red light beams over a dark cliff with ragged banners and ram skulls. In it: one sky whale far off in the sky, small, in the same pixel art, colours and light as everything around them. Rendered entirely in crisp, deliberately clustered pixel art. Modern high quality pixel art like Sea of Stars: bright, colourful and readable, never muddy.", "style_description": {"medium": "pixel_art", "art_style": "Authentic hand pixelled 2D game battle stage background. Visible square pixel clusters and stair stepped contours everywhere. Flat colour clusters, two to four shades per material. Crisp pixel edges without antialiasing. Clean readable shapes. No paint brushwork, no gradients except a dithered sky, no noise texture.", "aesthetics": "one coherent pixel art scene, coherent pixel clusters, small readable silhouettes, everything lit by the same light", "lighting": "Red eclipse light from above with ember glow, deep crimson shadows, as discrete flat pixel colour planes, the ground lit so it reads clearly.", "color_palette": ["#2a0a10", "#6a1418", "#c02a24", "#f06a2a", "#ffc070", "#1a1012", "#e8d8b8", "#b89870", "#3e302c", "#7a6250", "#96703e", "#f07828"]}, "compositional_deconstruction": {"background": "a crimson eclipse sky with red light beams over a dark cliff with ragged banners and ram skulls", "elements": [{"type": "obj", "bbox": [46, 187, 328, 734], "desc": "a sky whale: a huge whale floating in the air, swimming to the left, pale grey skin, long trailing fins and patches of corroded bronze barnacles on its back"}]}}
